note.question: What role does comparative analytics play in queueing systems?
note.overview: Much of the focus of queueing theory (QT) is on performance evaluation that supports comparative analytics—that is, comparing performance measures under different interventions. However, closed-form queueing models are very sensitive to assumptions. The paper develops a data-driven Structural Causal Queueing Model (SCQM)—a form of structural causal models that automatically adapts to the data-generating process of queueing systems, finds causal relations, and supports comparative analytics.
